cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.

mechanism: A directs a cancellation announcement and accepts standing beside B and taking questions, so B will still utter the painful first sentence.
confusable: Unlike routing bad news through rank, A bargains over support and division of work; borrowed authority depends on securing B first announcement.
comparison: Public choir cancellation with refund questions differs from a shared family phone call about selling a home.
seedUse: Use D101-a choir/tour/forms/funding critically with S02-b accommodating the announcer; preserve hamster reference separately without copying hierarchy.
